name: task_search
description: Search Task or Goal titles, descriptions and IDs with a nonempty expression and optional tag and other filters. Results are ranked lean pages. Repeat the same query and filters with nextCursor; changes cause search_changed. Use task_list for tag-only queries.

parentId.description: Omit for all parents; null selects unparented tasks; a Goal UUID selects its direct children.

tagIds.description: Project tag UUIDs; applied with other filters before pagination or the ready limit. Empty means no tag condition unless untagged is true.

tagMatch.description: Match all selected tags or any selected tag; defaults to all.

untagged.description: Select resources without tags; conflicts with a nonempty tagIds set.

query.description: Nonempty text expression: AND, OR, NOT, parentheses, quoted terms and id:, title:, description: fields. Tag names are not text fields.

taskParentView.description: Select the ordinary Task parent projection. Omit to keep the default Goal-only parentId fields.

parentTaskId.description: Select direct children of this visible ordinary Task in the same Project; conflicts with parentId.
